text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some fan mail has arrived for Air Shakur.

However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just put them all over there. It's not like
there's
anything worth reading.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: They've gotta be weirdos if they're writing to me. I bet they're not even expectin' me to read it all anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and get training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're supposed to be a pro, so try
acting
like one. Leave all your personal
feelings outta
this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: They're my fans. I'm allowed to think whatever I want about them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And I don't care what they think about
me either.
Everyone's equal, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What? I just said I don't freakin' need
th—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we finish training, I go to put
the fan
mail in a storage box. As I do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A single postcard falls to the floor, and I

accidentally catch a glimpse of the
contents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"When I was having trouble at work,
seeing you
run with such determination
really helped me find
courage. That's
why I won't ask you to do your
best."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm writing this letter just to let you
know that
you have people like me out
there cheering for
you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, another fan letter
arrives. Once
more, Air Shakur shows no
interest in opening the
envelope. Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not have a typical relationship
with her
fans, but there's unmistakably
some kind of bond
at work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that makes me even more
excited to
train her.
